items.caption: Complete apartment renovation — Prague 6, done in 6 weeks
items.title: Complete apartment renovation
items.excerpt: From a bare shell to a turnkey home — wiring, floors and a custom kitchen.
items.body:
The client took over a 1970s apartment in its original state. We handled full demolition, new wiring and plumbing, plastering, floors and a custom kitchen. Handover on schedule, at the fixed quoted price.

We also coordinated the kitchen studio and delivered built-in wardrobes. The apartment was handed over cleaned, with documentation and a 5-year warranty.

items.caption: Painting and interior renovation — family house, Kladno
items.title: Painting and interior renovation
items.excerpt: Walls, ceilings and woodwork renovated in an occupied home — stress-free, spotless cleanup.
items.body:
The owners wanted a refresh without moving out. We covered the furniture, repaired cracks, sanded and repainted walls and ceilings in three rooms, working room by room.

Done in four days including cleanup, at exactly the quoted price.

items.caption: Turnkey new build — from shell to finished kitchen, Průhonice
items.title: Turnkey new build — shell to kitchen
items.excerpt: Complete fit-out of a new build: services, plasters, floors, bathrooms and a custom kitchen.
items.body:
The investor handed us the house at shell stage. We delivered all finishing work — services, plasters, screeds, bathroom tiling and kitchen installation. One team, one schedule, weekly progress reports.

Handed over on the contracted date with full documentation and a 5-year warranty.

faq.title: What clients ask most often
faq.lead: Can't find your answer? Send us a free enquiry or call 704 123 456 — we reply within 24 hours.

items.question: Is the enquiry and quote really free?
items.answer: Yes. The enquiry, consultation and quote are completely free and non-binding. You only pay for work actually done.

items.question: How fast can you come?
items.answer: We respond to standard enquiries within 24 hours. For emergencies we operate 24/7 — usually within 90 minutes across Prague.

items.question: Do you honour the quoted price?
items.answer: Yes. After the site visit the price is fixed. Extra work only happens with your approval — you will never be surprised by an invoice.

items.question: What warranty do you give?
items.answer: We provide a written 5-year warranty on workmanship. Equipment carries the manufacturer's warranty. We are insured up to CZK 5 million.

items.question: Which area do you cover?
items.answer: We work in Prague and the Central Bohemia region up to 40 km. More distant locations are handled individually — just ask.
